name: Gods Gifts
overview: Scripture reveals that all good and perfect gifts originate from God, the unchanging Father of lights, who graciously provides blessings to His people (James 1:17). Central among these gifts is eternal life, given through faith in Jesus Christ, God's only begotten Son, who was sent out of love to redeem sinners (John 3:16; Romans 6:23; Ephesians 2:8). Believers also receive the gift of the Holy Spirit upon repentance and baptism, empowering them for holy living (Acts 2:38). Additionally, God bestows diverse spiritual gifts according to His grace, enabling believers to serve and build up the body of Christ (Romans 12:6).
